subject: ACME: Admin activity ledger preservation & delivery playbook
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Security <compliance@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: admin activity logs and export format for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Stephanie,

We're preparing our SIG and SOC 2 evidence bundle and need clarity on Redwood's admin activity logging for the past 13 months. Specifically we need:

- Complete field list for admin activity extracts (timestamp, actor id/email, action, resource id/type, request_id, src_ip, auth_method, region, request_payload_hash)
- Whether you can provide raw event-level records vs. aggregated/summary views
- Retention windows (policy + practical snapshot availability for 13 months)
- Export formats supported (CSV/JSON/Parquet) and per-file size estimates
- Delivery options: presigned S3, encrypted Drive share, or FedRAMP-approved transfer (our preference: presigned S3 with AES-256 SSE-KMS)
- Chain-of-custody manifest and MD5/SHA256 checksums for exported bundles

Can you confirm what you can deliver and an estimated timeline? We have an audit snapshot deadline on 2027-02-20.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Security & Privacy Program Manager
Acme Health

--
(Attachment: sample_sgq_request_template.pdf)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs and export format for SOC 2/SIG

Elena / team,

Thanks for the clear list. Ben/Monica/Vivek — ACME needs a 13-month export with chain-of-custody and checksums, delivery preference is presigned S3 + manifest. Audit deadline 2027-02-20.

Can you propose:
- Extraction window and snapshot cadence (one-off full export vs incremental)
- Output schema and sample row for sign-off
- Encryption and key handling approach (we normally do SSE-KMS; confirm KMS key rotation implications)
- Estimated completion date and any expected blockers (size, time to restore transient logs)

I'll loop back to Acme once we have an internal plan.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Feb 2027 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: admin activity logs and export format for SOC 2/SIG

Stephanie / team / Elena,

Summary of proposed extraction plan (13-month window):

1) Snapshot approach
- One full historic export covering 2026-01-01 -> 2027-01-31 (13 months) pulled from our immutable admin-activity ledger.
- Also provide a small incremental export for events up to the handoff date if needed.

2) Output schema (attached: admin_activity_export_spec.csv)
- timestamp_utc, actor_email, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, src_ip, user_agent, auth_method, region, event_payload_hash, event_id
- Sample row included in sample_admin_activity_snippet.csv

3) Formats & packaging
- Primary: newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) and compressed CSV (gzip). Parquet available on request for large datasets.
- Files will be split by month and compressed; estimate ~11-14 GB total for 13 months (depends on verbosity of payload hashes).

4) Encryption & delivery
- We will upload to a customer-provided S3 bucket or our secure staging S3 and provide presigned, time-limited GET URLs.
- All at-rest encryption will be SSE-KMS. If Acme requires a customer-managed key, we can support cross-account KMS grants; needs 48-72h to arrange.

5) Chain-of-custody & checksums
- We will include a JSON manifest (admin_activity_manifest_v1.json) listing each file, record count, uncompressed size, gzip size, and SHA256 checksums.

6) Timeline
- Preliminary export + manifest: 2027-02-09 (internal QA)
- Delivery to Acme (presigned link + manifest): 2027-02-10 if no KMS cross-account block.

Blockers: requesting customer-managed KMS keys or cross-account roles will add 2-3 business days. Very large payloads requiring rehydration from cold storage could extend extraction time.

Attached: admin_activity_export_spec.csv (schema), sample_admin_activity_snippet.csv (preview).

Let me know if you want parity fields added (e.g., request_path, query_params redaction flag).

-Ben
Ben Carter
Infrastructure Security Lead, Redwood Inference
(attachment stubs: admin_activity_export_spec.csv, sample_admin_activity_snippet.csv)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmehealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: admin activity logs and export format for SOC 2/SIG -- Delivery

Hi Elena / team,

We completed the export and packaged the evidence per Ben's spec. Deliverables:

- admin-activity-20260101-20270131-ndjson-00.gz (monthly partitions, ndjson)
- admin-activity-20260101-20270131-csv-00.gz (gzipped CSV)
- admin_activity_manifest_v1.json (file-level manifest + SHA256 checksums)
- sample_admin_activity_snippet.csv (preview file)

Delivery method: presigned S3 URLs (time-limited, UTC expiry 2027-02-17T23:59:00Z). For security we used Redwood-staging bucket and generated single-use GET URLs. If you prefer the files moved to an Acme-owned bucket and SSE-KMS with your CMK we can coordinate cross-account roles (will need IAM contact).

Chain-of-custody notes:
- Exported directly from immutable admin ledger snapshot (no manual edits).
- Manifest includes SHA256 for every file and a top-level signed manifest checksum.
- Audit trail of export job available in operator logs (job ids: OP-58231, OP-58232).

Links / references:
- Evidence folder (read-only drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example
- HubSpot ticket: 18422

Attached: admin_activity_manifest_v1.json, presigned_s3_instructions.txt (instructions and expiry summary).

If you confirm receipt and checksum match, we'll mark the package as delivered for your audit. If you require customer KMS or a different transfer method, we can do a second delivery window — please advise ASAP.

Best,
Monica Patel
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachments: admin_activity_manifest_v1.json, presigned_s3_instructions.txt)
